note: quote-anchored:valueText=官方原文,本步每轮验证其仍逐字在页面上;字段语义见 basis。覆盖 job offer(社区指定雇主/社区推荐/优先行业或职业)、工作经验(1,560 小时/3 年窗/TEER 相近表/TEER 5 同码/社区毕业生豁免)、语言(CLB 按 TEER 三档)、学历(境内高中或以上/境外 ECA)、安家资金(fundsMinimum 按 familySize 分档,fundsPerAdditionalMember 是超 7 人后的每人递增)。RCIP 是社区推荐制:哪个社区、优先职业、指定雇主名单不在本表,那是 rcip 域三份清单的事。

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: have a valid job offer from a designated employer in the community
requirements.label: Job offer must come from an employer designated by the recommending community

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: Once you have a valid job offer from a designated employer, they will send your community recommendation application directly to the community to review.
requirements.label: The designated employer sends the community recommendation application to the community for review

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: your job is in a priority sector or occupation and the offer is real
requirements.label: The community checks that the job is in a priority sector or occupation and the offer is real

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: you need at least 1 year (1,560 hours) of related work experience in the past 3 years
requirements.label: At least 1 year (1,560 hours) of related work experience in the past 3 years

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: Volunteer work and unpaid internships don't count.
requirements.label: Work experience must be paid; volunteer work and unpaid internships don't count

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: not be from a self-employed job
requirements.label: Self-employment does not count toward the work experience requirement

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: be in a similar TEER as your job offer
requirements.label: Work experience must be in a similar TEER to the job offer (official table; TEER 5 offers need the same 5-digit NOC)

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: Same 5-digit NOC code
requirements.label: For a TEER 5 job offer the work experience must be in the same 5-digit NOC code

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: You don't need to meet the work experience requirement if you're an international student who graduated from a public post-secondary school in the community with:
requirements.label: International students who graduated from a public post-secondary school in the community are exempt from the work experience requirement

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: an eligible credential in a program of 2 years or longer
requirements.label: Exemption credential must be from a program of 2 years or longer (or a master's or higher of 2 years or less)

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: got your credential no more than 18 months before applying for permanent residence
requirements.label: Exemption credential must have been received no more than 18 months before applying for PR

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: were in the community for at least 16 of the last 24 months while studying
requirements.label: Must have been in the community for at least 16 of the last 24 months while studying

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: TEER 0 or 1: CLB 6
requirements.label: CLB 6 minimum for a job offer in TEER 0 or 1

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: TEER 2 or 3: CLB 5
requirements.label: CLB 5 minimum for a job offer in TEER 2 or 3

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: TEER 4 or 5: CLB 4
requirements.label: CLB 4 minimum for a job offer in TEER 4 or 5

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: These results must be less than 2 years old when you apply.
requirements.label: Language test results must be less than 2 years old when you apply

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: Canadian secondary school (high school) diploma
requirements.label: Education in Canada: a Canadian secondary school (high school) diploma or a recognized post-secondary credential

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: An educational credential assessment (ECA) report from a designated organization or professional body that:
requirements.label: Education outside Canada: an educational credential assessment (ECA) from a designated organization

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: is less than 5 years old on the date you apply
requirements.label: The ECA must be less than 5 years old on the date you apply

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: You do not need to show proof of funds if you're already working in Canada with a valid work permit.
requirements.label: No proof of funds needed if already working in Canada with a valid work permit

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.valueText: If more than 7 people, for each additional family member, add $2,831
requirements.label: For each family member beyond 7, add $2,831 CAD

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: Minimum settlement funds for a family of 1: $10,507 CAD

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: Minimum settlement funds for a family of 2: $13,080 CAD

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: Minimum settlement funds for a family of 3: $16,080 CAD

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: Minimum settlement funds for a family of 4: $19,524 CAD

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: Minimum settlement funds for a family of 5: $22,143 CAD

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: Minimum settlement funds for a family of 6: $24,975 CAD

requirements.subject: applicant
requirements.label: Minimum settlement funds for a family of 7: $27,806 CAD
